question: In which state is the Maski inscription located at present?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maski** is a small town located in the **Raichur district of Karnataka.**
 
• The Maski inscription is an **important archaeological discovery** as it is one of the earliest known examples of **Brahmi script,** dating back to the **3rd century BCE.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Maski inscription is written in Brahmi Script.
 
• It contains information about the Mauryan Emperor Ashoka's policies and his appointment of an official named Tindivanu to oversee the administration of the region.
 
• It was discovered by **C. Beadon in 1915** and later studied in detail by archaeologist **Robert Sewell.**
